visualCharacteristics.purpose: tab bar switching panels of content (state-specific product panels, resources, FAQs, research topics)

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: label (text, optional icon) | panel content (any rich content). A panel holding only a bare page URL loads that page as a fragment so it can contain other blocks; links under /fragments/ are loaded by the page's auto-blocking. A label that is a link with an empty panel is a link tab

reuseGuidance: Use for in-page tabbed content. Put complex panels (cards, columns) in fragments and link them from the panel cell. Icons and Icons 2 stack an icon above each label; Alt options centre the strip; Grey and Image options box the panel.
decisions: Panels with blocks load from fragments via loadFragment (blocks/fragment/fragment.js).
Catalog member v_ba665a55d43b is a multi-step form progress indicator, not tabs; authored as link tabs it renders as a strip. Reclassify with excat-catalog-manager if needed.
